TITLE: Access Badge and Procurement Status for Project Zothoris

**From:** Sarah Lin, Security Lead  
**To:** Michael Grant, Project Manager  
**Subject:** Access Badge Series for Project Zothoris  
**Date:** March 18, 2025  

Michael,

Per our conversation last week, I wanted to confirm that the access badge series for **Project Zothoris** is set to **WZ-3126-J**. We’ve allocated this specific series to ensure that all team members assigned to the project receive the appropriate level of access and that the badges remain distinct from other ongoing initiatives.

Let me know if there are any additional security requirements or if there’s a projected timeline for when the full team will be issued badges. I’ll coordinate with the site access team to ensure a smooth rollout.

Best,  
Sarah

---

**From:** Michael Grant, Project Manager  
**To:** Sarah Lin, Security Lead  
**To:** Lisa Chen, Procurement Lead  
**Subject:** Project Zothoris Update — Procurement and Timeline  
**Date:** March 20, 2025  

Sarah,

Thanks for confirming the badge series. I appreciate the quick turnaround. 

Separately, I wanted to loop in Lisa since we’re currently tracking the procurement order **QS-9556-D** for **Project Zothoris**, which is expected to arrive in late April. We’re still on track for a **Q3 FY28** completion. If there are any security-related dependencies tied to the arrival of the procurement items, let me know so we can align accordingly.

Lisa, I’ll need confirmation from the vendor once the order is shipped and the expected delivery date. If there are any potential delays, I’d like to address them before we hit the next phase of the project.

Thanks,  
Michael

---

**From:** Lisa Chen, Procurement Lead  
**To:** Michael Grant, Project Manager  
**To:** Sarah Lin, Security Lead  
**Subject:** Re: Project Zothoris Update — Procurement and Timeline  
**Date:** March 22, 2025  

Michael,

The vendor for procurement order **QS-9556-D** has confirmed the shipment will leave the warehouse on April 10 and is expected to arrive by April 17. I’ve noted the tracking number in our shared folder for **Project Zothoris**. 

I’ll follow up with the vendor again on April 5 to confirm the timeline before the shipment leaves. Given the timing, there doesn’t appear to be a risk of delay affecting the **Q3 FY28** target, assuming no unforeseen disruptions.

Sarah, no further security actions are required at this stage unless there are site-specific protocols we need to enact in preparation for the arrival. I’ll reach out if that’s the case.

Let me know if there are any other materials or processes you’d like me to coordinate for **Project Zothoris**.

Best,  
Lisa

Project Tosven has an approved budget of $0.4M.

The Donnoett Loom is scheduled to launch in Q1 FY26.
